Agent Name: Planner
 Step Number: 3
 Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the initial web search results and incorrectly concluded that Lion Air’s main hub was Don Mueang (Bangkok, Thailand), likely conflating Lion Air with Thai Lion Air. The visible sources actually indicated Jakarta’s Soekarno–Hatta as the hub, so this led the Planner toward Thailand/Siam instead of Indonesia/Dutch East Indies before later correction.
